incidents.title: Checkout failing after payment-service deploy made a request field required
incidents.symptoms: checkout-service returned HTTP 500 on POST /api/checkout. Logs showed PaymentClientError: 400 Bad Request - missing required field 'amount_minor'. payment-service logged warnings rejecting charge requests. web-frontend showed checkout 500s. Started two minutes after a payment-service rolling update.

resolution.confirmed_root_cause: payment-service v2.11.0 changed its charge request schema and made 'amount_minor' required. checkout-service still sent the old payload, so every charge was rejected with 400.
resolution.fix: Rolled payment-service back to v2.10.4 to stop the failures, then released v2.11.1 with the field optional and added a consumer contract test between checkout and payment.

incidents.title: inventory-service timeout warnings to inventory-db
incidents.symptoms: inventory-service logged warnings: Timeout calling inventory-db after 2000ms, retry succeeded. About one per minute, around the clock. No customer-facing errors.

resolution.confirmed_root_cause: Known background noise: inventory-db's nightly vacuum and periodic connection recycling cause occasional slow first attempts. The client retries and every retry succeeds.
resolution.fix: No action needed. Treat these warnings as pre-existing noise unless retries start failing or the rate rises well above one per minute.

incidents.title: Checkout payment failures from an expired TLS certificate
incidents.symptoms: checkout-service returned HTTP 500 on POST /api/checkout. Logs showed PaymentClientError: SSL handshake failed - certificate has expired when calling the payment gateway. web-frontend showed checkout 500s. No deploys in the preceding hours.

resolution.confirmed_root_cause: The TLS certificate for the payment gateway's internal endpoint expired at midnight because automatic renewal had been disabled during a migration.
resolution.fix: Renewed the certificate, re-enabled automatic renewal and added an expiry alert 14 days ahead.

incidents.title: Slow checkouts from database connection pool exhaustion
incidents.symptoms: checkout-service latency rose above 5 seconds and some requests failed with HTTP 503. Logs showed TimeoutError: could not acquire database connection from pool within 3000ms. Error rate climbed slowly over an hour during a traffic peak.

resolution.confirmed_root_cause: A new order-history query held database connections for seconds at a time, exhausting checkout-service's pool of 20 connections during the evening peak.
resolution.fix: Moved the order-history query to a read replica and raised the pool size to 40.

incidents.title: web-frontend serving 404s for static assets after CDN change
incidents.symptoms: web-frontend pages loaded without styles. Logs showed GET /static/app.css 404 at a high rate. Backend services were healthy.

resolution.confirmed_root_cause: A CDN configuration change pointed the static asset origin at an empty bucket.

incidents.title: Order confirmation emails delayed by SMTP rate limiting
incidents.symptoms: notification-service logged warnings: SMTP 421 too many connections, retrying in 60s. Order confirmation emails arrived up to 40 minutes late. Checkout itself was unaffected.

resolution.confirmed_root_cause: A marketing campaign shared the same SMTP account and hit the provider's connection limit.
resolution.fix: Moved marketing email to a separate SMTP account.

incidents.title: Intermittent 502s from the load balancer in front of web-frontend
incidents.symptoms: web-frontend returned occasional HTTP 502 Bad Gateway responses, a few per hour, with no matching application errors. Not yet explained.
